sections.name: Verse 1
lines: [F]Dying [C7]with [F]Jesus, by [Bb]death reckoned [F]mine,
[C7]Living with Jesus, a [F]new life divine,
Looking to Jesus till glory doth shine,
Moment by moment, O Lord, I am Thine.
Moment by moment I’m kept in His love;
Moment by moment I’ve life from above;
Looking to Jesus till glory doth shine;
Moment by moment, O Lord, I am Thine.

sections.name: Refrain
lines: [F]Moment [C7]by moment [F]I'm [Bb]kept in [F]His love;
[C7]Moment by moment [F]I've life from above;
Looking to Jesus till glory doth shine;
Moment by moment, O Lord, I am Thine.

sections.name: Verse 2
lines: [F]Never [C7]a trial [F]that [Bb]He is [F]not there,
[C7]Never a burden that [F]He doth not bear,
Never a sorrow that He doth not share,
Moment by moment I'm under His care.

sections.name: Verse 3
lines: [F]Never [C7]a [F]heart-ache, and [Bb]never [F]a groan,
[C7]Never a teardrop [F]and never a moan;
Never a danger but there on teh throne,
Moment by moment He thinks of His own.

sections.name: Verse 4
lines: [F]Never [C7]a weakness [F]that [Bb]He doth [F]not feel,
[C7]Never a sickness [F]that He cannot heal;
Moment by moment, in woe or in weal,
Jesus, my Savior, abides with me still.
